newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Chrysler mulls Portugal presence - paper.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler mulls Portugal presence - paper.

text.p: U.S. carmaker Chrysler Corp is looking at ways to set up in Portugal, the only western European country where it has no presence, the president of Chrysler Europe told the daily Diario Economico.

Timothy Adams told the paper that Chrysler was currently deciding whether to set up a direct branch in Portugal or appoint representatives who would work with the company's Madrid subsidiary. A third option would be to sign a contract with a Portuguese importer.
Adams said the carmaker had had discussions with the Portuguese government about the possibility of setting up a components plant in Portugal. He said nothing had been decided.
The government has provided other foreign car manufacturers with incentives to build factories in Portugal.
